# Security policy

The service handles SourceCraft credentials, repository metadata and security
findings. Never commit tokens, generated reports containing secrets, or raw
provider payloads.

Please report vulnerabilities privately to the repository maintainers rather
than opening a public issue. Include a minimal reproduction, affected version,
impact and mitigation if known.

Runtime guarantees and redaction rules are documented in
[`docs/sourcecraft.md`](../docs/sourcecraft.md).
